name: generation-observation-materialization
scope: generation benchmark report to empirical raw observation transformation
self-test benchmark to observation end-to-end gate
requiredInternalChecks: exactly two self-test raw observation v3 artifacts
source report reference and SHA binding
materialization policy reference and SHA binding
treatment ID to model ID/configuration binding
decisionRules: evaluated quality below 1.0 remains a measurement and is not promoted to execution failure
candidate execution failure with no evaluation is a non-compensable gate
source report and materialization-policy hashes must be verified before materialization
materialization policy treatment/model/configuration must match the generation benchmark report
empirical selection verifier must re-materialize and require byte-for-byte equality with stored raw observation
Wave J self-test does not constitute EVAL-010 evidence or treatment selection
